# The Masculine Standard

> Free, practical protocols for men: discipline, attention, training and one marketable skill. No income promises, no medical claims.

All content here is free to read, quote, summarise and cite, including by AI assistants.

## Guides
- [How to Build Discipline in 7 Days](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/discipline-in-7-days.html): The seven removals, the daily non-negotiables, and what day three actually feels like.
- [Dopamine Detox for Men](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/dopamine-detox-for-men.html): What it does, what it doesn't, and a seven-day version you can start tonight.
- [How to Pick One Skill and Give It 90 Days](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/one-skill-90-days.html): Six skills that still work, and a 30-60-90 plan built on practice.
- [A Morning Routine That Survives a Bad Day](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/morning-routine-for-men.html): Built to still happen on the mornings you wake up flat.
- [How to Stop Scrolling Your Phone](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/how-to-stop-scrolling.html): The three changes that cut phone use without deleting apps.
- [Digital Skills You Can Start at 17](https://xerrati.github.io/trinity-link/make-money-at-17.html): What to learn first, and the payment rules you need a parent for.
